I have resolved the issue by updating the MySQL backend connection parameters to use `'database'` and `'password'` instead of the deprecated `'db'` and `'passwd'` keyword arguments:

- In [`django.db.backends.mysql.base.DatabaseWrapper.get_connection_params`](file:///testbed/django/db/backends/mysql/base.py#L202-L205), changed `kwargs['db']` to `kwargs['database']` and `kwargs['passwd']` to `kwargs['password']`.
- In [`django.db.backends.mysql.client.DatabaseClient.settings_to_cmd_args_env`](file:///testbed/django/db/backends/mysql/client.py#L11-L14), updated `db` retrieval from `settings_dict['OPTIONS']` to also check for `'database'` in addition to `'db'`, mirroring the behavior of `'password'`/`'passwd'`.
